Clustering R6 Class (Internal)

Source: R/bcall_classes.R
Clustering.Rd

Internal R6 class for automatic legislator clustering. Users should use bcall_auto() instead.

Public fields

N

Distance metric (1=Manhattan, 2=Euclidean)

X

Rollcall data matrix

clusters

List of cluster assignments

clustering

Final clustering dataframe
